evidence: Built criterion->requirement map for all 28 criteria (2 gates, 16 functional, 6 polish, 4 visual). Every graded demand traces to the public brief or a professional default: client scope/signed-out emptiness (instruction.md 'Until somebody signs in...'; integration.md last line); plain 'not available' for walled/other-client routes incl. the Gwen->M-12 post replay and the JUDGE-W2 cross-matter reply (walls-and-retention.md 'nothing back but a plain "not available". The same goes for clients...'); cross-matter reply refusal (conversations.md Replies); JUDGE-W3 is lenient (refuse OR file in parent's matter); @-suggestions exact membership incl. never Dev in M-12 / never Paul in M-11, lower-case '@dev', edit/delete-driven mentions (conversations.md Mentions); live wall within ~10 s (walls doc); three-level nesting + R1B order + quotes (Replies); deleted-parent placeholder, exactly-7-day boundary, edit-does-not-rejuvenate, shorten deletes at once, off/lengthen never restores, partner-only timer/hold, hold scope, release deletes overdue, typed 'On hold' (walls doc); stale-edit refusal keeping typed text, staff-only earlier versions, author-only edit/delete (Edits); literal markup in thread/quote/snippet/versions/transcript, http(s) link new tab (Formatting); link preview/not available/highlight persists (Links); per-user cross-tab unread, new-messages line, mark unread, deleted not counted (Unread); duplicate-send once, same-time order C,A,B everywhere, Enter/Shift+Enter/Escape, 10 s live updates preserving draft/scroll, 390 px no sideways scroll applied to transcript (Sending/live); case-insensitive literal substring search incl. %,_,* and 'urvey booked' ('looks for exactly the characters typed'); transcript heading number/title/generated time, oldest-first threads, author, own sent time, edited, hold mark, versions of held edited message, no chat controls (Search and transcripts); restart persistence of listed state (integration.md); refusal reason next to form and persistent (walls doc last line); delete confirm. No exact label, route, payload, selector or golden-only rule is graded: functional prompt says 'Any endpoint path, payload shape or cookie name is acceptable', controls matched by intent, earlier-versions and suggestion request recording are conditional ('If the app lets...', 'If showing the suggestions made a request'), times 'any clear format', matter list 'beside the thread or on its own screen'. Seed facts cited by criteria verified (K-10 at 05-05T11:00:00Z exactly 7 d, K-11 +1 s, K-14 survives under expired K-1 with held K-15, K-17 held 9 d old, K-13 with 2,400 version, K-18 3 May, K-2 held with 'Landlords notice recieved.', K-3 2026-05-08T15:00; 'Fenwick'/'heads of terms' only in M-12). Notes (not defects): sign-out (signin_and_client_scope, refusal_in_place) is not in the brief but is the house sign-in convention per Internal annotation and SKILL known false positive and is needed to 'sign in as different people'; the polish id 'transcript_print' actually grades phone width, which the brief requires; visual likert anchors ('calm badge', 'document-like') are craft defaults with graded anchors, not pass/fail mandates; cross-tab unread sync uses the brief's ~10 s live window, consistent with 'the same in every tab'. Residual (not measured): unread leg 4 expects Gwen's M-13 count >=2 at sign-in; an app that auto-opens the most recently active matter on sign-in would clear it legitimately, but auto-open is unrequired and the golden does not do it (app.js openMatter only on route/user action). No full configured judge run exists for these bytes (raw-evidence-index scope), so judge over-literal interpretation is not measured here; that belongs to judge-reliability rows, not to what criteria enforce.
